desc: The Cold Steel Trapper Folding Knife features handles with authentic bone and are highlighted with polished metal bolsters. The rugged handles are substantially sized for hard work, even with gloved hands. It is constructed in a traditional Jack Knife pattern, with two polished blades, a clip point blade for piercing and cutting and a spey blade for skinning and gutting, both folding out of one end of the knifes grip.
